definition: Pi is an open-source artificial intelligence coding agent and agent harness developed by Earendil Works.
details: It operates primarily through a terminal user interface and allows large language models to read, write, and modify source code and execute shell commands. Pi is designed around a small extensible core and can be customized using TypeScript extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes, and packages.
story: Think of a chess player who never commits to a move blindly — they consider the board, try an action, watch what changes, and only then decide what is next. The machine stops just answering one question and starts getting a job done, step by step, checking its work along the way. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Pi (AI agent).
